app.name: CalculaHora
app.tagline: Simple time tracking with Google Sheets

auth.title: Connect Google
auth.description: Your data stays in your Google account. We store tokens only in this browser.

landing.badge: Free · Your data in Google Sheets
landing.heroTitle: Track your time, keep your data
landing.heroSubtitle: Simple time tracking that stores everything in your Google Drive. Start a timer, organize by project, and export reports — no subscription required.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to track time
landing.featuresSubtitle: A focused time tracker with the essentials — timer, projects, reports, and exports.

timer.title: Live timer
timer.description: Start and stop timers in one click. Edit entries manually when you need to.

projects.title: Projects & rates
projects.description: Organize work by project with billable flags, hourly rates, and currencies.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Filter by date range and project. See totals and billable amounts at a glance.

sheets.title: Google Sheets backend
sheets.description: Each workspace is a spreadsheet in your Drive. Open it in Sheets anytime.

export.title: CSV & PDF export
export.description: Download filtered reports for invoicing, payroll, or your own analysis.

privacy.title: Privacy first
privacy.description: Tokens stay in your browser. Your time entries never leave your Google account.

landing.howSubtitle: No setup wizard, no vendor lock-in — just sign in and track.

connect.title: Connect Google
connect.description: Sign in with your Google account. We only access spreadsheets this app creates.

workspace.title: Create a workspace
workspace.description: A new spreadsheet is created in your CalculaHora folder on Drive.

track.title: Track & report
track.description: Log time, assign projects, and export reports whenever you need them.

landing.ctaSubtitle: Connect with Google and create your first workspace. Your spreadsheet, your rules.
landing.footerNote: Built for freelancers and small teams

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.subtitle: Each workspace is a spreadsheet in your CalculaHora folder.
workspaces.empty: No workspaces yet. Create your first one.

settings.title: Workspace settings
settings.description: Timezone and time display format for this workspace.

tracker.title: What are you working on?
tracker.runningEditHint: Set duration to stop this timer with a calculated end time.
tracker.deleteConfirmDescription: This cannot be undone. The entry will be removed from your spreadsheet.
